annotations.title: Heuristic bullish/bearish tone of news on a keyword (lexicon, not a model)

description:
Heuristic bullish/bearish tone of news on a keyword (lexicon, not a model). Scores each item matching q in the last N hours (1-168, default 24) with a keyword/emoji lexicon (rise/beat/upgrade vs. fall/miss/sanctions, ⬆️/⬇️) plus explicit '= ±X%' moves, and returns bullish/bearish/neutral counts, score = (bullish - bearish)/count in [-1, 1], a label and examples. method is always 'heuristic'.

GET /news/sentiment — price $0.005 USDC per call, paid automatically via x402 on Base (only successful responses are charged; 400/404/502 are free).

hours.description: Look-back window in hours (default 24, clamped to 1-168) Default: 24.

q.description: Keywords (case-insensitive). Several words = all must match. Hashtags match with or without '#', e.g. 'oil', '#Fed rates'.

name: get_news_sentiment
title: Heuristic bullish/bearish tone of news on a keyword (lexicon, not a model)
